task: population sequential-KL decomposition and single-path HMM acquisition lower bound
status: identity proved; finite-sample counterexample proved for stated ergodic family; general rank-free acquisition theorem UNKNOWN

claims.claim: For finite-alphabet stationary history H, future block F, statistic T of H, and decoder q(.|T), expected conditional KL equals I(F;H|T) plus E KL(P(F|T)||q(.|T)).

For every training length n there is a stationary ergodic two-state, four-symbol HMM with positive noisy emissions and no uniform transition-gap lower bound such that every predictor trained from one raw path has worst-case expected stationary one-step conditional-KL risk greater than 0.0141 nats.
The lower bound applies to all learners, including same-data full-path likelihood/model-selection baselines, even after revealing nuisance transition/emission values.
The decomposition is a population identity, not a data-acquisition oracle; a uniform finite-sample result needs quantitative mixing/coverage or another interface promise.
